items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: He was the big music publisher and promoter on Broadway. ... we gave it there and it was such a success that we moved on to other places there. And we moved on to Sweden.

ctx.x: No. This was a concert of our own. We gave it in the concert hall. I mean, the symphony hall. What's that man's name, now? At that time -- I guess he's dead, now.
Maybe that was the name. Anyhow, ---
